subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's operation-gated outbound delivery resolver and QQBot READY/RESUMED pending-delivery drain as the intended compatibility behavior for setup-only or operation-limited channel registrations?
rationale: Root policy treats fallback/setup and channel delivery behavior as compatibility-sensitive; this patch changes plugin selection order for sends and adds reconnect-time replay, which needs maintainer ownership even though no concrete defect was found in the diff.

options.title: Accept Current Semantics
options.body: Land after exact-head gates remain green; this fixes the linked message-loss path while preserving the shared resolver for action and non-send callers.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller maintainer-directed adjustment to operation gating or QQBot drain scope if multi-account or legacy pending-entry replay feels too broad.

options.title: Pause Or Replace
options.body: Close or supersede this PR if maintainers want a different repair shape, such as bootstrap invalidation only or a QQBot-local reconnect fix.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Semantics
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head gates remain green; this fixes the linked message-loss path while preserving the shared resolver for action and non-send callers.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent owner for the outbound resolver and bootstrap routing semantics this PR changes.
